findings.reason: a §2 node hits 15 batches it must apply and cannot, and the 582 domain placements have no section that owes them applied.
findings.text: §2's first done-when item requires every batch in sib-consistency-batches.json applied, except the batches §3 and §4 own, while the section's own prose (line 44) says it makes no physics_domain change and that the grouping placements are §5's; the artifact's rows carry edit axes d/g: 582 rows are g-only and 135 batches mix d and g (15 batches are entirely g-only, 56 rows). `sn edit --axis` accepts only name|docs|both (`.claude/skills/sn-edit/SKILL.md:26`), so a §2 node cannot apply those rows at all, and §5's done-when does not require those 56 placements applied — it only requires the census's divergent count to fall below 98. The measure therefore fails a compliant §2 and closes a §5 that never touched them

findings.reason: one name's rename and 147 export-set-driven documentation edits are each owed by the section that measures them and excluded by the section that could apply them, so both fall between two done-whens.
findings.text: §2 cedes "the release-candidate renames of the momentum_flux and momentum_source unit pairs" to §3, but the artifact's rename batch is batch-272 with three rows, the third being source_rate_due_to_beam_beam_fusion; §3 has no prose or done-when item that owns a rename, and its unit-warning measure (line 61) names only the momentum_flux and momentum_source families, so the third name's warning can stand while §3 passes. The same gap covers the six advisory batches (274–279, 147 names, documentation edits pruned against rc8's export set): §2 keeps them by default because only §3's and §4's are excepted, yet §3's first done-when item is precisely the warning set those edits clear

findings.reason: as written the node either breaches its own cap or fails its first done-when, and the escalation the text implies is not a declared dependency.
findings.text: the new whole-pass cap of USD 60 is 37% of the sizing artifact's own total estimate of USD 159.115 at the documentation rate, and `sn edit` also pays for review, so the measured rate will be higher still; item 1 of the done-when ("every batch … applied") and item 5 ("the pass total beside its USD 60 cap") cannot both hold, and item 1 carries no clause making the lead's lift of the cap a precondition
